testCases.description: Single point on date: global q cat / value.query dog => reject RAW_SERIES_IDENTITY_MISMATCH
Multi-value point on date: query matching value[1] must bind pointer /values/1, not /values/0
Multi-value point with duplicate queries on same date => reject RAW_ROW_AMBIGUOUS
Point without value.query: uses search_parameters.q only if canonical matches
Point without value.query AND without search_parameters.q: receipt only q rejected unless signed attestation
Date matching point with different interval end date => reject INTERVAL_MISMATCH
Numeric tolerance: extracted_value 75 vs demandValue 76 (>0.01 delta) => reject RAW_VALUE_MISMATCH
Floating point within tolerance (75.0001 vs 75.0) => accept
Unix timestamp in seconds vs observation ISO date: correctly aligns and verifies
Unix timestamp in milliseconds vs observation ISO date: correctly aligns and verifies
As-of cutoff enforcement: future date relative to asOfTimestamp => reject POINT_IN_TIME_VIOLATION
Captured-at timestamp after observation date: historical observation is valid
Region mismatch: payload US vs observation GB => reject REGION_MISMATCH
Scope mismatch: workspaceId or researchRunId cross-tenant pollution => reject RUN_MISMATCH
Product mismatch: observation productId != receipt productId => reject PRODUCT_MISMATCH
Non-timeseries ad creative response => reject NO_TIMESERIES_SUPPORT
Non-timeseries merchant PDP response => reject NO_TIMESERIES_SUPPORT
Malformed JSON payload => reject UNSUPPORTED_RAW_SCHEMA
Empty timeline_data array => reject RAW_SERIES_MISSING
Tampered raw payload (hash mismatch against receipt) => reject HASH_MISMATCH
Punctuation and casing differences match canonically => accept
Token overlap without full match ('water fountain' vs 'pet water fountain') => reject RAW_SERIES_IDENTITY_MISMATCH
Cadence detection: daily intervals detected as DAILY, weekly detected as WEEKLY
Hourly interval spanning midnight detected as HOURLY
